video_uri.description: HTTPS URI of the source video to enhance

source_container.description: Container format of the source video

source_width.description: Width of the source video in pixels

source_height.description: Height of the source video in pixels

frame_count.description: Total frame count of the source video (used by Topaz for credit estimation)

frame_rate.description: Frame rate of the source video in frames per second (e.g. 29.97)

sharpness.description: Amount of sharpening applied to the enhanced video
